<input id="RefreshOnBack" type="hidden"/>
<script>
            window.onbeforeunload = function () { $('#RefreshOnBack').val(true); };
            if ($('#RefreshOnBack').val() == 'true') { $('#RefreshOnBack').val(false); document.location = document.location; };
        </script>
</div>
</section>
<script>
        var CS_DomesticRoute = "",
            arrRecentAirport = null,
            departDate, returnDate, tempDate,
            todayDate = new Date(),
            Search_Data = [],
            Search_Time = [],
            searchWait = false;

        todayDate = new Date(todayDate.getFullYear(), todayDate.getMonth(), todayDate.getDate());

        function clearDepartureAirport() {
            $('#hdfDepartureAirport').val('');
            $('.airport-departure').removeClass('has-value');
            $('.airport-departure .clear-command').removeClass('active');
            $('#lblDepartureAirport li.item-text').text('');
            $('#lblDepartureAirport .airport-code').html('<span>Chọn điểm khởi hành</span>');
        };
        function clearArrivalAirport() {
            $('#hdfArrivalAirport').val('');
            $('.airport-arrival').removeClass('has-value');
            $('.airport-arrival .clear-command').removeClass('active');
            $('#lblArrivalAirport li.item-text').text('');
            $('#lblArrivalAirport .airport-code').html('<span>Chọn điểm đến</span>');
        };
        function GetMessage() {
            departDate = parseDate($("#hdfDepartureDate").val(), "dd-MM-yyyy", "-");
            returnDate = parseDate($("#hdfReturnDate").val(), "dd-MM-yyyy", "-");
            var vMesssage = "";
            if ($("#hdfDepartureAirport").val() == "") vMesssage += ",\ Đi từ";
            if ($("#hdfArrivalAirport").val() == "") vMesssage += ",\ Đi đến";
            if ($("#hdfDepartureDate").val() == "") vMesssage += ",\ Ngày đi";
            if (vMesssage.length > 0) {
                vMesssage = "Bạn chưa chọn" + vMesssage.substr(1, 100);
            }
            else if (todayDate > departDate)
                vMesssage = 'Ngày đi phải bằng hoặc sau ngày hiện tại ' + FormatDate(todayDate, "dd/MM/yyyy");
            else if (returnDate != null && returnDate < departDate)
                vMesssage = 'Ngày về phải lớn hơn hoặc bằng ngày đi ' + FormatDate(departDate, "dd/MM/yyyy");
            else {
                var departCode = $("#lblDepartureAirport .airport-code").text().toUpperCase();
                var arrivalCode = $("#lblArrivalAirport .airport-code").text().toUpperCase();
                if (departCode == arrivalCode)
                    vMesssage = "Điểm đi và điểm đến phải khác nhau";
                else {
                    if (departCode == 'NHA') departCode = 'CXR'; if (arrivalCode == 'NHA') arrivalCode = 'CXR';
                    if ((CS_DomesticRoute.indexOf(departCode) >= 0 && CS_DomesticRoute.indexOf(arrivalCode) >= 0)
                        && CS_DomesticRoute.indexOf(departCode + '-' + arrivalCode) == -1 && CS_DomesticRoute.indexOf(arrivalCode + '-' + departCode) == -1)
                        vMesssage = 'Hành trình ' + departCode + '-' + arrivalCode + ' hiện chưa có hãng hàng không nào khai thác';
                }
            }
            return vMesssage;
        }
        function ValidSearch() {
            var vMesssage = GetMessage();
            if (vMesssage !== "") {
                ShowMessage(vMesssage);
                LogMessage(vMesssage);
                return false;
            }
            else {
                RecentAirport("ArrivalAirport");
                RecentAirport("DepartureAirport");
                /**/
                $(".search-button .btnSearchReCaptcha").attr("onclick", "return true;");
                setTimeout(function () {
                    $(".search-button .btnSearchReCaptcha").click();
                }, 100);
                return false;
            }
        }
        function preloadIMG() {
            var arrImages = [];
            for (var i = 0; i < preloadIMG.arguments.length; i++) {
                arrImages[i] = new Image();
                arrImages[i].src = preloadIMG.arguments[i];
            }
        }
        function getVNDayName(currentDate) {
            var vnDaysOfWeek = ['<span class="sun-day">C.Nhật</span>', 'T.Hai', 'T.Ba', 'T.Tư', 'T.Năm', 'T.Sáu', '<span class="sat-day">T.Bảy</span>'];
            return vnDaysOfWeek[currentDate.getDay()] + ',\xa0';
        };
        function setLunarDateText(lunarDateSelector, currentDate) {
            var lunarDate = getLunarDate(currentDate.getDate(), currentDate.getMonth() + 1, currentDate.getFullYear());
            $(lunarDateSelector).html('(âm lịch:\xa0' + lunarDate.day + '-' + lunarDate.month + ')');
        };
        function changeDepartDate() {
            var arrDepartDate = $("#hdfDepartureDate").val().split("-");
            if (arrDepartDate.length == 3) {
                departDate = new Date(arrDepartDate[2], parseInt(arrDepartDate[1] - 1), arrDepartDate[0]);
                if (departDate < todayDate) {
                    departDate = todayDate;
                    $("#hdfDepartureDate").val(FormatDate(departDate, "dd-MM-yyyy"));
                }
                $("#lblDepartureDate").html(getVNDayName(departDate) + FormatDate(departDate, "dd-MMM-yyyy")).attr("data-month", FormatDate(departDate, "yyyy-MM"));
                setLunarDateText('#lunarDepartureDate', departDate);
                $('body').trigger('has-value');
                $('#pnlSearch .date-departure').addClass('has-value');
                $("#pnlSearch .date-departure .clear-command").addClass("active");
            } else {
                $("#lblDepartureDate").text($("#lblDepartureDate").attr("title"));
                $('#pnlSearch .date-departure').removeClass('has-value');
                $("#pnlSearch .date-departure .clear-command").removeClass("active");
            }
        }
        function changeReturnDate() {
            var arrReturnDate = $("#hdfReturnDate").val().split("-");
            if (arrReturnDate.length == 3) {
                returnDate = new Date(arrReturnDate[2], parseInt(arrReturnDate[1] - 1), arrReturnDate[0]);
                $("#lblReturnDate").html(getVNDayName(returnDate) + FormatDate(returnDate, 'dd-MMM-yyyy')).attr("data-moth", FormatDate(returnDate, 'yyyy-MM'));

        function RecentAirport(vType) {
            var airportData = {};
            airportData["code"] = $("#lbl" + vType + " .airport-code").text().toUpperCase();
            airportData["name"] = $("#lbl" + vType + " .airport-name").text();
            airportData["country"] = $("#lbl" + vType + " .airport-country").text();
            if (arrRecentAirport == null) arrRecentAirport = new Array();
            var i = arrRecentAirport.findIndex(function (a) { return (a["code"] == airportData["code"]); });
            if (i > -1) arrRecentAirport.splice(i, 1);
            arrRecentAirport.splice(0, 0, airportData);
            if (arrRecentAirport.length > 10) arrRecentAirport.pop();
            if (typeof (Storage) !== "undefined") {
                localStorage.setItem("RecentAirport", JSON.stringify(arrRecentAirport));
            }
        }

        function parseIntEx(oVal) {
            var ret = parseInt(oVal);
            return isNaN(ret) ? 0 : ret;
        }
        function parseDate(vValue, vFormat, vSep) {
            if (vSep == null) vSep = "/";
            else vFormat = vFormat.replace(new RegExp(vSep, "g"), "/");
            var arrValue = vValue.split(vSep);
            switch (vFormat) {
                case "dd/MM/yy":
                case "dd/MM/yyyy":
                    return new Date(arrValue[2], parseIntEx(arrValue[1]) - 1, arrValue[0]);
                    break;
                case "MM/dd/yy":
                case "MM/dd/yyyy":
                    return new Date(arrValue[2], parseIntEx(arrValue[0]) - 1, arrValue[1]);
                    break;
                case "yy/MM/dd":
                case "yyyy/MM/dd":
                    return new Date(arrValue[0], parseIntEx(arrValue[1]) - 1, arrValue[2]);
                    break;
                default:
                    return null;
                    break;
            }
        }
        function FormatDate(vValue, vFormat) {
            if (typeof vValue.getDate != "function")
                return "";
            else {
                var monthfield = vValue.getMonth() + 1;
                var dayfield = vValue.getDate();
                if (dayfield < 10) dayfield = "0" + dayfield;
                if (monthfield < 10) monthfield = "0" + monthfield;
                vFormat = vFormat.replace("yyyy", vValue.getFullYear());
                vFormat = vFormat.replace("yy", vValue.getYear());
                vFormat = vFormat.replace('-MMM-', ' tháng ' + monthfield + ',\xa0');
                vFormat = vFormat.replace("MM", monthfield);
                vFormat = vFormat.replace("dd", dayfield);
                return vFormat;
            }
        }

                $.ajax({

        function ClearDate(vRel) {
            if (vRel == null) {

            }
            $("#lbl" + vRel).text($("#lbl" + vRel).attr("title"));
            $('#lunar' + vRel).text('');

        function SearchAirport(txtInput) {
            if (!searchWait) {
                searchWait = true;
                setTimeout(function () {
                    var vInput = ("" + $(txtInput).val()).toLowerCase();
                    if (vInput.length <= 1 || $(txtInput).attr("alt") == vInput) {
                        if (vInput.length == 0) ClearSearch($(txtInput).parent());
                    }
                    else {
                        $(txtInput).attr("alt", vInput).parent().removeClass("active");;
                        vInput = "s=" + vInput + "&type=airport";
                        var vTime = new Date().getHours();
                        if (Search_Time[vInput] != null && (vTime - Search_Time[vInput]) / 1000 < 180) {
                            SearchSuccess(txtInput, Search_Data[vInput], SelectAirport);
                            $(txtInput).parent().addClass("active");
                        }
                        else {
                            var vUrl = vInput + "&limit=15&t=" + vTime;
                            $(txtInput).addClass("searching");
                            $.get("/Ve-may-bay/AutoSuggest.aspx?" + vUrl, function (resData) {
                                SearchSuccess(txtInput, resData, SelectAirport);
                                Search_Data[vInput] = resData;
                                Search_Time[vInput] = vTime;
                                $(txtInput).removeClass("searching").parent().addClass("active");
                            });
                        }
                    }
                    searchWait = false;
                }, 400);
            }
            else return;
        }
        function SetFilter(vText, objParent) {
            $(".airport-filter-path div", objParent).html(vText);
            if (vText == "")
                $(objParent).removeClass("filter").children(".airport-filter-path").hide();
            else
                $(objParent).addClass("filter").children(".airport-filter-path").show();
            $(".airport-scroll", objParent).scrollTop(0);
        }
        function ClearSearch(objPanel) {
            var objParent = $(objPanel).parents(".panel-item:first");
            SetFilter("", objParent);
            $("input", objParent).val("").attr("alt", "").parent().removeClass("active");
            var vType = objParent.attr("type");
            $(".airport-result", objParent).html($("#pnlHidden .airport-default." + vType).html()).find("a").click(function () { var $this = $(this); SelectAirport($this); });
            $(".airport-filter-box", objParent).hide().filter("." + vType).show();
        }
        function SearchSuccess(txtInput, vData, clickFunction, filterTitle) {
            var objParent = $(txtInput).parents(".panel-item:first");
            if (filterTitle == null) {
                SetFilter("", objParent);
            }
            else {
                if (filterTitle.indexOf(">") > 0)
                    filterTitle = $(".airport-filter-path div", objParent).text() + filterTitle;
                SetFilter(filterTitle, objParent);
            }
            var divResult = $(".airport-result", objParent).html("").append(vData);
            $("a", divResult).click(function () { var $this = $(this); clickFunction($this); });
        }
        function SearchContinent(objA) {
            var $this = $(objA);
            if ($this.attr("data-filter") == "VN") {
                SearchSuccess($this, $("#pnlHidden .airport-default.dom").html(), SelectAirport, "Việt Nam");
                return;
            }
            var vTime = new Date().getDay();
            var vInput = "s=" + $this.attr("data-filter") + "&type=continent";
            var vText = $this.attr("title");
            if (vText == null) vText = $this.text();
            if (Search_Time[vInput] != null && (vTime - Search_Time[vInput]) / 1000 < 600) {
                SearchSuccess($this, Search_Data[vInput], SearchCountry, vText);
            }
            else {
                var vUrl = vInput + "&t=" + vTime;
                ShowWaiting();
                $.get("/Ve-may-bay/AutoSuggest.aspx?" + vUrl, function (resData) {
                    HideMessage();
                    SearchSuccess($this, resData, SearchCountry, vText);
                    Search_Data[vInput] = resData;
                    Search_Time[vInput] = vTime;
                });
            }
        }
        function SearchCountry(objA) {
            var $this = $(objA);
            var vTime = new Date().getDay();
            var vInput = "s=" + $this.attr("data-filter") + "&type=country";
            if (Search_Time[vInput] != null && (vTime - Search_Time[vInput]) / 1000 < 600) {
                SearchSuccess($this, Search_Data[vInput], SelectAirport, " > " + $this.attr("data-name"));
            }
            else {
                var vUrl = vInput + "&t=" + vTime;
                ShowWaiting();
                $.get("/Ve-may-bay/AutoSuggest.aspx?" + vUrl, function (resData) {
                    HideMessage();
                    SearchSuccess($this, resData, SelectAirport, " > " + $this.attr("data-name"));
                    Search_Data[vInput] = resData;
                    Search_Time[vInput] = vTime;
                });
            }
        }

        function CalendarInit() {
            var dToday = new Date();
            $(".responsive-calendar").attr("data-month", dToday.getFullYear() + "-" + (dToday.getMonth() + 1));
            $(".responsive-calendar .controls a").click(function () {
                var objCalendar = $(this).parents(".responsive-calendar"),
                    dataMonth = $(objCalendar).attr("data-month"),
                    vYear = parseInt(dataMonth.split("-")[0]),
                    vMonth = parseInt(dataMonth.split("-")[1]);
                if ($(this).attr("data-go") == "prev") {
                    vMonth -= 1;
                } else {
                    vMonth += 1;
                }
                if (vMonth == 13) {
                    vMonth = 1;
                    vYear += 1;
                }
                else if (vMonth == 0) {
                    vMonth = 12;
                    vYear -= 1;
                }
                $(objCalendar).attr("data-month", vYear + "-" + vMonth);
                CalendarBind(objCalendar);
            });
        }
        function CalendarShow(objCalendar, dataMonth, dataDate) {
            if (dataMonth != null) {
                $(objCalendar).attr('data-month', dataMonth);
            }
            if (dataDate != null) {
                $(objCalendar).attr('data-date', dataDate);
            }
            CalendarBind(objCalendar);
        }
        var CalendarDays = ["sun", "mon", "tue", "wed", "thu", "fri", "sat"];
        var LunarDays = ["1/1", "15/1", "3/3", "5/5", "15/7", "15/8", "23/12"];
        function CalendarBind(objCalendar) {
            var dataMonth = $(objCalendar).attr("data-month");
            var dataDate = parseInt($(objCalendar).attr("data-date"));
            var vYear = parseInt(dataMonth.split("-")[0]);
            var vMonth = parseInt(dataMonth.split("-")[1]);
            $(".controls span[data-head-month]", $(objCalendar)).text("Tháng " + vMonth);
            $(".controls span[data-head-year]", $(objCalendar)).text(vYear);
            var vRel = GetPanelRel(objCalendar);
            var vMin = 0;
            var vMax = 0;
            if (vRel == "DepartureDate" && returnDate != null) vMax = returnDate.getTime();
            else if (vRel == "ReturnDate" && departDate != null) vMin = departDate.getTime();
            /**/
            vMonth = vMonth - 1;
            var vDate = new Date(vYear, vMonth, 1);
            var vDow = vDate.getDay();
            if (vDow > 1) vDate = new Date(vYear, vMonth, 1 - (vDow - 1));
            else if (vDow == 0) vDate = new Date(vYear, vMonth, 1 - 6);
            var t = "";
            for (var i = 1; i <= 42; i++) {
                t += "<div class='day " + CalendarDays[vDate.getDay()];
                var vTime = vDate.getTime();
                if (vTime == todayDate.getTime()) t += " today";
                if (vTime == dataDate) t += " active";
                if (vTime == vMin) t += " min";
                if (vTime == vMax) t += " max";
                if (vDate.getMonth() != vMonth) t += " not-current";
                t += "'>";
                t += "<a data-day='" + vDate.getDate() + "' data-month='" + (vDate.getMonth() + 1) + "' data-year='" + vDate.getFullYear() + "'>" + vDate.getDate();
                var ldate = getLunarDate(vDate.getDate(), vDate.getMonth() + 1, vDate.getFullYear());
                t += "<sub";
                var lday = ldate.day + "/" + ldate.month;
                if (LunarDays.indexOf(lday) > -1) t += " class='holiday'";
                t += ">";
                t += "" + ldate.day;
                if (ldate.day == 1 || LunarDays.indexOf(lday) > -1) t += "/" + ldate.month;
                t += "</sub>";
                t += "</a>";
                t += "</div>";
                /**/
                vDate = new Date(vDate.setTime(vDate.getTime() + 1 * 86400000));
                if ((vDate.getMonth() > vMonth || vDate.getFullYear() > vYear) && vDate.getDay() == 1) break;
            }
            $(".days", $(objCalendar)).html(t);
            $(".days a", $(objCalendar)).click(function () { CalendarClick($(this)); });
        }
        function CalendarClick($this) {
            var vDate = String_PadLeft($this.data('day'), "00") + "-" + String_PadLeft($this.data('month'), "00") + "-" + $this.data('year');
            var displayDate = '';
            var vRel = GetPanelRel($this);
            if (vRel == "DepartureDate") {
                tempDate = new Date($this.data('year'), $this.data('month') - 1, $this.data('day'));
                if (todayDate > tempDate) {
                    ShowMessage('Ngày đi phải bằng hoặc sau ngày hiện tại'); return;
                }
                departDate = tempDate;
                displayDate = getVNDayName(departDate) + FormatDate(departDate, 'dd-MMM-yyyy');
                setLunarDateText('#lunarDepartureDate', departDate);
            }
            else if (vRel == "ReturnDate") {
                tempDate = new Date($this.data('year'), $this.data('month') - 1, $this.data('day'));
                departDate = parseDate($("#hdfDepartureDate").val(), "dd-MM-yyyy", "-");
                if (todayDate > tempDate) {
                    ShowMessage('Ngày về phải bằng hoặc sau ngày hiện tại'); return;
                }
                returnDate = tempDate;
                displayDate = getVNDayName(returnDate) + FormatDate(returnDate, 'dd-MMM-yyyy');
                setLunarDateText('#lunarReturnDate', returnDate);
            }
            var vMonth = $this.data('year') + "-" + String_PadLeft($this.data('month'), "00");
            $("#lbl" + vRel).html(displayDate).attr("data-month", vMonth);
            $("#hdf" + vRel).val(vDate);
            $(".day.active", objCalendar).removeClass("active");
            $this.parent().addClass("active");
            var objCalendar = $this.parents(".responsive-calendar:first");
            if (vMonth != objCalendar.attr("data-month")) {
                objCalendar.attr("data-month", vMonth);
                objCalendar.attr("data-date", tempDate.getTime());
                CalendarBind(objCalendar);
            }
            HidePanel();
            if (vRel == "ReturnDate") {
                $('body').trigger('has-value');
                $('#pnlSearch .date-return').addClass('has-value');
                $("#pnlSearch .date-return .clear-command").addClass("active");
            }
            if (vRel == "DepartureDate") {
                $('body').trigger('has-value');
                $('#pnlSearch .date-departure').addClass('has-value');
                $("#pnlSearch .date-departure .clear-command").addClass("active");
            }
        }

            0x2d4b63, 0x525370, 0x3e49e8, 0x60c970, 0x4c54b0, 0x3768a6, 0x5ada50, 0x445aa0, 0x2fa6a4, 0x54aad0,
            0x4052e0, 0x28d2e3, 0x4ec950, 0x38d557, 0x5ed4a0, 0x46d950, 0x325d55, 0x5856a0, 0x42a6d0, 0x2c55d4,
            0x5252b0, 0x3ca9b8, 0x62a930, 0x4ab490, 0x34b6a6, 0x5aad50, 0x4655a0, 0x2eab64, 0x54a570, 0x4052b0,
            0x2ab173, 0x4e6930, 0x386b37, 0x5e6aa0, 0x48ad50, 0x332ad5, 0x582b60, 0x42a570, 0x2e52e4, 0x50d160,
            0x3ae958, 0x60d520, 0x4ada90, 0x355aa6, 0x5a56d0, 0x462ae0, 0x30a9d4, 0x54a2d0, 0x3ed150, 0x28e952
        ); /* Years 2000-2099 */

        /* Create lunar date object, stores (lunar) date, month, year, leap month indicator, and Julian date number */
        function LunarDate(dd, mm, yy, leap, jd) {
            this.day = dd;
            this.month = mm;
            this.year = yy;
            this.leap = leap;
            this.jd = jd;
        }

        function INT(d) {
            return Math.floor(d);
        }

        function jdn(dd, mm, yy) {
            var a = INT((14 - mm) / 12),
                y = yy + 4800 - a,
                m = mm + 12 * a - 3,
                jd = dd + INT((153 * m + 2) / 5) + 365 * y + INT(y / 4) - INT(y / 100) + INT(y / 400) - 32045;

            return jd;
            /*return 367*yy - INT(7*(yy+INT((mm+9)/12))/4) - INT(3*(INT((yy+(mm-9)/7)/100)+1)/4) + INT(275*mm/9)+dd+1721029*/;
        }

        function jdn2date(jd) {
            var Z, A, alpha, B, C, D, E, dd, mm, $yyyy, F;
            Z = jd;
            if (Z < 2299161) {
                A = Z;
            } else {
                alpha = INT((Z - 1867216.25) / 36524.25);
                A = Z + 1 + alpha - INT(alpha / 4);
            }

            B = A + 1524;
            C = INT((B - 122.1) / 365.25);
            D = INT(365.25 * C);
            E = INT((B - D) / 30.6001);
            dd = INT(B - D - INT(30.6001 * E));
            if (E < 14) {
                mm = E - 1;
            } else {
                mm = E - 13;
            }
            if (mm < 3) {
                $yyyy = C - 4715;
            } else {
                $yyyy = C - 4716;
            }

            return new Array(dd, mm, $yyyy);
        }

        function decodeLunarYear(yy, k) {
            var monthLengths, regularMonths, offsetOfTet, leapMonth, leapMonthLength, solarNY, currentJD, j, mm, ly = [];
            monthLengths = new Array(29, 30);
            regularMonths = new Array(12);
            offsetOfTet = k >> 17;
            leapMonth = k & 0xf;
            leapMonthLength = monthLengths[k >> 16 & 0x1];
            solarNY = jdn(1, 1, yy);
            currentJD = solarNY + offsetOfTet;
            j = k >> 4;
            for (i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
                regularMonths[12 - i - 1] = monthLengths[j & 0x1];
                j >>= 1;
            }
            if (leapMonth == 0) {
                for (mm = 1; mm <= 12; mm++) {
                    ly.push(new LunarDate(1, mm, yy, 0, currentJD));
                    currentJD += regularMonths[mm - 1];
                }
            } else {
                for (mm = 1; mm <= leapMonth; mm++) {
                    ly.push(new LunarDate(1, mm, yy, 0, currentJD));
                    currentJD += regularMonths[mm - 1];
                }
                ly.push(new LunarDate(1, leapMonth, yy, 1, currentJD));
                currentJD += leapMonthLength;
                for (mm = leapMonth + 1; mm <= 12; mm++) {
                    ly.push(new LunarDate(1, mm, yy, 0, currentJD));
                    currentJD += regularMonths[mm - 1];
                }
            }
            return ly;
        }

        function getYearInfo($yyyy) {
            var yearCode = TK21[$yyyy - 2000];
            return decodeLunarYear($yyyy, yearCode);
        }

        var FIRST_DAY = jdn(25, 1, 1800), /* Tet am lich 1800 */
            LAST_DAY = jdn(31, 12, 2199);

        function findLunarDate(jd, ly) {
            if (jd > LAST_DAY || jd < FIRST_DAY || ly[0].jd > jd) {
                return new LunarDate(0, 0, 0, 0, jd);
            }
            var i = ly.length - 1;
            while (jd < ly[i].jd) {
                i--;
            }
            var off = jd - ly[i].jd;
            ret = new LunarDate(ly[i].day + off, ly[i].month, ly[i].year, ly[i].leap, jd);
            return ret;
        }

        function getLunarDate(dd, mm, $yyyy) {
            var ly, jd;
            if ($yyyy < 1800 || 2199 < $yyyy) {
                /*return new LunarDate(0, 0, 0, 0, 0);*/
            }
            ly = getYearInfo($yyyy);
            jd = jdn(dd, mm, $yyyy);
            if (jd < ly[0].jd) {
                ly = getYearInfo($yyyy - 1);
            }
            return findLunarDate(jd, ly);
        }
        /**/
        $(function () {
            var searchBy = "";
            try {
                if (getParam("gclid") != null)
                    searchBy = "GA";
                else {
                    switch (getParam("utm_source")) {
                        case "Facebook":
                            searchBy = "FA";
                            break;
                        case "coccoc_newtab_media":
                        case "coccoc_context":
                        case "coccoc_icon":
                            searchBy = "CA";
                            break;
                        default:
                            if (document.referrer != null) {
                                var refer = document.referrer.split('/')[2];
                                if (refer == null) return;
                                if (refer.indexOf("google.com") > 0) searchBy = "GG";
                                else if (refer.indexOf("facebook.com") > 0) searchBy = "FB";
                                else if (refer.indexOf("coccoc.com") > 0) searchBy = "CC";
                            }
                            break;
                    }
                }
                if (window.location.href.split('?')[0].indexOf("/ve-may-bay") > 0) searchBy += ".LP";
                else if (window.location.href.split('?')[0].indexOf("/tin-tuc/") > 0) searchBy += ".TT";
                else if (searchBy != "") searchBy += ".";
                document.cookie = "SearchBy=" + searchBy;
            }
            catch (err) {
                console.log(err.message);
            }
        });

        function getParam(pName, vUrl) {
            if (!vUrl) vUrl = window.location.href;
            pName = pName.replace(/[\[\]]/g, "\\$&");
            var regex = new RegExp("[?&]" + pName + "(=([^&#]*)|&|#|$)"),
                results = regex.exec(vUrl);
            if (!results) return null;
            if (!results[2]) return '';
            return decodeURIComponent(results[2].replace(/\+/g, " "));
        }
    </script>

<script>
        $(function () {
            var parseDate = function (dateText) {
                var segments = dateText.split(/[^0-9]/);
                return new Date(segments[0], segments[1] - 1, segments[2], segments[3], segments[4], segments[5]);
            };

            $.ajax({
                type: 'POST',
                url: '/default.aspx/GetLatestOrderInfor',
                dataType: 'json',
                contentType: 'application/json; charset=utf-8',
                success: function (result) {
                    if (!result.d || result.d == 'null') {
                        return;
                    }

                    var latestOrderInfor = JSON.parse(result.d)[0],
                        departureDate = Date.parse(latestOrderInfor.DepartureDate);
                    if (latestOrderInfor.IsRoundTrip) {
                        var returnDate = parseDate(latestOrderInfor.ReturnDate);
                        if (Date.now() > returnDate) {
                            return;
                        }
                    } else {
                        if (Date.now() > departureDate) {
                            return;
                        }
                    }

                    var getRoutesText = function (orderInfor) {
                        var resultText = orderInfor.DepartureAirport + '-' + orderInfor.ArrivalAirport;
                        if (orderInfor.IsRoundTrip) {
                            resultText += '-' + orderInfor.DepartureAirport;
                        }

                        return resultText;
                    };

                    var getVNDayName = function(currentDate) {
                        var vnDaysOfWeek = ['C.Nhật', 'T.Hai', 'T.Ba', 'T.Tư', 'T.Năm', 'T.Sáu', 'T.Bảy'];
                        return vnDaysOfWeek[currentDate.getDay()];
                    };

                    var getDatesText = function (orderInfor) {
                        var departureDate = parseDate(orderInfor.DepartureDate),
                            resultText = departureDate.getDate() + '/' + (departureDate.getMonth() + 1);

                        if (orderInfor.IsRoundTrip) {
                            var returnDate = parseDate(orderInfor.ReturnDate);
                            resultText += '-' + returnDate.getDate() + '/' + (returnDate.getMonth() + 1);
                        } else {
                            resultText = getVNDayName(departureDate) + ' ' + resultText;
                        }

                        return resultText;
                    };

                    var htmlContent = 'Vé đã đặt: <span class="latest-order-routes">' +
                        getRoutesText(latestOrderInfor) +
                        '</span><span class="latest-order-dates">' +
                        getDatesText(latestOrderInfor) +
                        '</span><a href="Ve-may-bay/Quan-ly-booking.aspx?OrderId=' + (latestOrderInfor.PhoneNumber || latestOrderInfor.MobilePhone || latestOrderInfor.OrderId) + '">Chi Tiết</a>';
                    $('.hot-line h1').html(htmlContent);
                }
            });

            $('.airport-departure, .airport-arrival, .date-departure, .date-return').append('<li class="background-item"></li>');
        });
    </script>

<script>
    $(function () {
        var offset = Math.min(screen.height*0.5, $(document).height() - screen.height)-36;
        if (offset > 36) {
            var duration = 300;
            jQuery(window).scroll(function () {
                if (jQuery(this).scrollTop() > offset)
                    jQuery('#gotop').fadeIn(duration);
                else
                    jQuery('#gotop').fadeOut(duration);
            });
            jQuery('#gotop').click(function (event) {
                event.preventDefault();
                jQuery('html, body').animate({ scrollTop: 0 }, duration);
                return false;
            });
        }
    });
</script>
